body:
Resource and clearing field preparation occupy a substantial part of the simulation's synchronous path. This change specializes the direct seeding kernels and shares walking/swimming resource seed templates across preparation requests. Requests copy a template into their owned buffer, then apply current resource goals, fog, market stock and team restrictions.

`GradientRuntime` owns the cache. Explicit Map mutation methods and const tile/resource views prevent writes from silently bypassing tracking. A deduplicated dirty queue and membership bitsets maintain relevant cells. Small maps, heavy mutation, over-budget maps and optional allocation failure use direct preparation. Storage is capped at 16 bytes per cell and 32 MiB per game. Clearing and guard fields retain their distinct precedence rules.

Field scheduling, publication deadlines, RNG calls, save/replay/network formats and simulation identity remain unchanged. No change in gameplay feel is intended. The original scalar predicates remain as a regression oracle; experiments, diagnostics and benchmark executables stay outside the production tree.

Validation on `b2850bb8b`:

- 607 headless engine tests and 17 editor/touch/rendering cases passed.
- 102 continuation comparisons matched every per-tick checksum, replay byte and final-save byte across nine fixtures, zero/one/two gradient workers and all eight pipeline save/resume phases.
- 27 browser cases passed across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, matching native traces for the standard replay, a 256×256 retained game and the committed golden match.
- 18 retained/synthetic preparation scenarios passed cell-for-cell cache/direct comparisons. The focused suite additionally covers the independent scalar oracle, custom terrain, allocation fallback and concurrency.
- Independent source review is complete; all reported findings were addressed.

Seven alternating pairs per primary scenario measured **5.3% lower whole-process CPU and 8.3% lower tick elapsed time** across all nine fixtures, relative to the optimized direct kernel. Large-map preparation used **91–96% less CPU**; heavy mutation and small maps fall back to direct preparation. Cache-owned capacity is about 0.83 MiB at 256×256 and 3.30 MiB at 512×512.

The [performance report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/729624627b7ce8bcd31603b8b5b924ad0d5def5b/performance-report.md) retains adverse primary samples and separately reports longer confirmations. Results support an overall improvement, with shared-host noise and a few-percent small-map median difference; uniform speedup is not claimed. [Verification evidence and reproduction commands](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/729624627b7ce8bcd31603b8b5b924ad0d5def5b) include raw accepted/rejected measurements, fixture hashes, logs, traces, saves and replays.

Native Windows, macOS, Android and ARM execution, dedicated market-heavy timing and manual gameplay evaluation remain outside this local verification scope. Source and measurement review findings have been addressed.

Local / VM verification

- **Tested commit:** `b2850bb8bcee98cdc9d0b0898c522073bd0ebc61`.
- **Base/integration:** master `71d7eee1b` merged in `4103be077`; current master `e444bebb0` fetched before final validation and again before completion. Its additional change is renderer-only fog fading, with no simulation overlap. The PR is mergeable.
- **Environment:** native Linux x86_64, AMD Threadripper 2950X, GCC 13; optimized C++20 with assertions, `-g1 -O3 -fno-omit-frame-pointer`, no math-setting changes. SDL dependency paths/hashes and Emscripten/browser build details are retained in the evidence.
- **Builds:** `GLOB2_SDL3_PREFIX=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix scons -j6 release=0 CXXFLAGS='-g1 -O3 -fno-omit-frame-pointer' --build=build/sim-profile build/sim-profile/src/glob2 build/sim-profile/test/glob2-engine-tests`; `scons target=web release=1 -j3`. Both completed. An earlier browser compiler crash was resolved by retrying unchanged source; the failure and successful retry logs are retained.
- **Native tests:** `python3 test/run_tests.py --build-dir build/sim-profile --binary engine --no-display --quick -j4 --timeout 600` → **607 passed**, zero failures, 103 skipped. Focused display selection `EditorActionCoverage/*`, `GameGUITouch/*`, `HighResolution*/*` → **17 passed**, zero failures. Output-directory/JUnit arguments and exact commands are in the evidence. The new nine-case gradient suite passed within this run.
- **Compatibility:** `verify-final.py` → **102 comparisons**, matching per-tick checksum traces, replay bytes and final saves across nine retained fixtures, worker configurations 0/1/2 with compute counts 1/2/4, and all eight save/resume phases. `browser-compatibility.py` → **27 cases** across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; native traces match serial and threaded variants on the standard replay and a 256×256 game, plus the committed golden match.
- **Preparation correctness:** `run-seed-performance.py --verify` → **18 scenarios** comparing every field to the direct kernel. The native gradient suite independently checks the scalar oracle, policies, mutations/removals, registry replacement, cache fallback, load/reset-related behavior and concurrency.
- **Performance:** seven alternating pairs for 18 preparation scenarios and nine 2,048-tick whole-game fixtures; three additional 8,192-tick pinned confirmations. Construction, maintenance, allocations and copying are charged to the cache. Correctness exports are disabled in timing. Whole pairs with excessive independently measured background CPU are rejected and retained separately. Across all nine primary fixtures, the geometric mean of per-fixture median paired ratios gives **5.3% lower whole-process CPU and 8.3% lower tick elapsed time**; the seven large-map windows give **7.3% and 12.0%**. Preparation on retained large maps is **91–96% lower** than the optimized direct kernel. The original late-game CPU +2.2% and short small-map latency +9.8% are retained; longer confirmations and their limits are shown separately. Small-map confirmation medians are within a few percent, with mixed signs; uniform improvement is not claimed.
- **Memory:** cache-owned capacity 865,088 bytes at 256×256 and 3,457,856 bytes at 512×512; 88 bytes when bypassed. Whole-process peak RSS is separately recorded.
- **Coverage rationale:** const Map access and mutation tracking touch engine, editor, AI and scripting callers; broad native checks cover those interfaces. Exact seed/continuation comparisons protect simulation identity and save/pipeline semantics. Browser traces cover the other available compiler/runtime boundary.
- **Omissions/limits:** no native Windows, macOS, Android or ARM execution; unrelated display/slow registry cases and the hosted full matrix were not requested. Dedicated market-heavy timing, real allocator exhaustion and manual gameplay feel evaluation were not performed. Cheap hosted checks passed and are not presented as engine verification.
- **Evidence:** [index and downloadable artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/729624627b7ce8bcd31603b8b5b924ad0d5def5b), [before/after report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/729624627b7ce8bcd31603b8b5b924ad0d5def5b/performance-report.md). Exact commands, revisions, fixture/binary/dependency hashes, raw accepted/rejected measurements, logs, traces, saves and replays are accessible there.
- **Author acceptance:** independent source and measurement reviews completed; findings addressed. Evidence accepted for this revision under the user's explicit merge authorization. Formats, simulation identity, RNG behavior and publication schedule remain unchanged.

Final base refresh: master advanced to `0e6f17204` with editor unit-preview and artwork changes. The two updated editor translation units compile against this PR’s tested Map interfaces. No simulation or gradient code changed. [Additional integration evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/1629882b915282903395fa6bb85cf5dc3e8cf560/latest-base.md) records the commands and scope. The tested PR head remains `b2850bb8bcee98cdc9d0b0898c522073bd0ebc61`.

title: Reduce synchronous gradient preparation with adaptive resource templates
